subject: Game Theory
title: Barriers to Entry
description: A fast breakdown of Barriers to Entry for builders.

hook.text: Why are there only three major credit card networks? Barriers to entry keep new competitors out.

buildup.text: Barriers include patents, brand loyalty, economies of scale, network effects, and regulatory requirements.

discovery.text: In game theory, barriers change the payoff matrix: entry becomes negative-expected-value for newcomers.

twist.text: Some barriers are natural (scale). Others are strategic: incumbents create them deliberately.

climax.text: Tech giants acquire potential rivals early, turning would-be competitors into controlled subsidiaries.

punchline.text: The best monopoly is one nobody can enter.

quiz.question: Which is a strategic barrier to entry?
